en.headline: CHP investigates new local Mpox case involving 32-year-old man
en.dek: The patient is in stable condition at Princess Margaret Hospital after developing fever, muscle pain and a rash; he had high-risk contacts with male strangers in Hong Kong.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said on Monday that it is investigating a confirmed local Mpox case involving a 32-year-old man who is in stable condition.

The patient developed fever and muscle pain on 11 August, followed by a rash on his face, trunk and lower body on 14 August. He attended a private clinic on 15 August and was arranged the same day for isolation treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital. Laboratory testing confirmed the specimen was positive for the Mpox virus.

According to the patient, he had not received Mpox vaccination and had multiple high-risk exposures with male strangers in Hong Kong during the incubation period. The centre said no epidemiological links with earlier confirmed cases in Hong Kong have been identified so far.
The CHP is continuing its epidemiological investigation, will try to contact people who had high-risk contact with the patient, and will notify the World Health Organization.

The centre again urged high-risk groups to receive Mpox vaccination and advised the public to avoid close physical contact with anyone suspected of having Mpox. Since 2022 Hong Kong has recorded 95 Mpox cases, of which 76 were local and 19 imported, all involving male patients.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查一宗本地猴痘個案 32歲男情況穩定
zh.dek: 患者出現發燒、肌肉痛及皮疹後入住瑪嘉烈醫院隔離，潛伏期曾在港與陌生男子有高風險接觸。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日表示，正調查一宗本地猴痘確診個案，涉及一名32歲男子，目前情況穩定。
患者本月11日起出現發燒及肌肉疼痛，14日起臉部、軀幹及下半身出現皮疹，15日到私家診所求醫，中心同日安排他到瑪嘉烈醫院接受隔離治療。樣本經中心公共衞生化驗服務處檢測，證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性。
根據病人提供的資料，他沒有接種猴痘疫苗，潛伏期內曾在香港與數名陌生男子有高風險接觸。中心表示，暫時沒有資料顯示個案與本港早前錄得的其他猴痘確診個案有流行病學關連。
中心正繼續進行流行病學調查，會設法聯繫與他有高風險接觸的人士，並會將個案通報世界衞生組織。
中心再次呼籲高風險目標群組盡快接種猴痘疫苗，市民應避免與懷疑感染猴痘的人士作密切身體接觸。自2022年起至今，本港共錄得95宗猴痘個案，其中76宗屬本地，19宗屬輸入，全部病人均為男性。
